speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have point tenderness when I press on the medial tibial plateau, and does the pain intensify with running or jumping? I want to rule out a medial meniscus tear or medial collateral ligament sprain.

text: Given the location of pain and your recent increase in volleyball activity, are you experiencing pain specifically when you run or jump, which would suggest medial tibial stress syndrome? REQUEST TEST: Knee_X-Ray
